npcs.name: Rook Vell
npcs.description: Fence associated with back rooms behind a shuttered tannery.
npcs.biography: Ask around town for a fence and someone will point you to Rook at back rooms behind a shuttered tannery. At 32, this Human has learned which smiles are currency and which are warnings. Rook never sits with his back to a door, and is rarely without ledger written in laundry marks. Hunted by Serra; crew with Silk and Jax; rivals Kitty. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to buy legitimacy through a 'respectable' shopfront. What keeps them careful is Serra getting a witness who won't scare. To a DM, Rook is ready to roleplay immediately—useful for favors, local color, or trouble. Claimed ownership of the mill tunnel against Kitty Shade.

npcs.name: Silk Mara
npcs.description: Pickpocket associated with market crowds and festival lines.
npcs.biography: Silk Mara works as a pickpocket out of market crowds and festival lines, a 29-year-old Half-Elf with more town memory than most council minutes. Silk apologizes while she steals, and is rarely without fingerless gloves with silk palms. Works for Rook; sells extras to Kitty. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to exit the life with one perfect score. What keeps them careful is Rook deciding she's a liability. To a DM, Silk is ready to roleplay immediately—useful for favors, local color, or trouble. Lifted Lina's note about Lysa's ring and sold the tip to Kitty.

npcs.description: Smuggler associated with a low river barge.
npcs.biography: Nedda Blacktooth works as a smuggler out of a low river barge, a 90-year-old Dwarf with more town memory than most council minutes. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to retire upriver with a clean name and dirty fortune. What keeps them careful is Brannic measuring her draft again. npcs.name: Pale Orin
npcs.description: Forgery Clerk associated with a tidy upstairs room near the clerk's hall.
npcs.biography: Pale Orin works as a forgery clerk out of a tidy upstairs room near the clerk's hall, a 43-year-old Human with more town memory than most council minutes. Pale washes ink from his hands until they crack, and is rarely without set of copied seals in clay. Forger for Rook; nervous around Penna. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to forge one document that buys him out forever. What keeps them careful is Penna Ledgerwell recognizing his pen pressure. To a DM, Pale is ready to roleplay immediately—useful for favors, local color, or trouble. Drafted a fake warehouse writ used in Rook's last shipment.

npcs.name: Kitty Shade
npcs.description: Information Broker associated with velvet booths and quiet balconies.
npcs.biography: Ask around town for a information broker and someone will point you to Kitty at velvet booths and quiet balconies. At 27, this Tiefling has learned which smiles are currency and which are warnings. Kitty tips well and remembers every favor owed, and is rarely without mirror compact with a poisoned pin unused. Rival to Rook; buys from Silk and Cressida. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to own the town's secrets market outright. What keeps them careful is Rook unifying the alleys without her. To a DM, Kitty is ready to roleplay immediately—useful for favors, local color, or trouble. Bought Cressida's Lysa rumor and auctioned a softer version to Edric's enemies.

npcs.name: Bask Hammer
npcs.description: Debt Collector associated with doorways of debtors.
npcs.biography: Most days begin the same for Bask Hammer: a 35-year-old Half-Orc debt collector moving through doorways of debtors as if the stones themselves keep appointments with them. Bask knocks politely, then harder, and is rarely without leather gloves lined with coin weights. Marrow's collector; clashed with Dorn. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to earn Marrow's partnership, not just wages. What keeps them careful is Dorn catching him in public again. To a DM, Bask is ready to roleplay immediately—useful for favors, local color, or trouble. Warned a baker that 'accidents' happen to ovens behind on interest.

npcs.name: Mouse Pip
npcs.description: Sewer Runner associated with sewer mouths and grate shadows.
npcs.biography: Mouse Pip works as a sewer runner out of sewer mouths and grate shadows, a 21-year-old Halfling with more town memory than most council minutes. Mouse apologizes to rats before he traps them, and is rarely without oilskin map folio of tunnels. Knows sewers; fed by Pola; tracked by Kessa. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to sell his maps to someone who won't kill him after. What keeps them careful is being sealed in below during a storm. To a DM, Mouse is ready to roleplay immediately—useful for favors, local color, or trouble. His tunnel sketch matches Wren's joke map and Rina's overheard 'mill tunnel'.
